Marta (Finance): Quick q on month-end recognition for a JPY prepaid commit. Invoice dated 2025-03-28, customer paid 1,200,000 JPY. We book in USD. Rate at invoice ≈0.007359 vs month-end ≈0.007208. Do we: a) defer at invoice USD and keep deferral in USD, or b) keep deferral in JPY and remeasure at month-end? Also how do we treat FX P&L? Need guidance for close tonight.

Liam (RevenueOps): My quick read: record at invoice spot in USD. FX differences hit FX P&L when cash settles. Tagging @Arjun to confirm.

Arjun (Accounting): Confirming guidance: because the contract/invoice is denominated in JPY, initial measurement uses spot at transaction date. Deferred revenue (unearned revenue) is a non-monetary liability so we generally do NOT remeasure it at each reporting date. Journal at invoice should use USD equivalent at invoice spot. Any FX gain/loss arises on monetary items (AR/cash) when remeasured at settlement.

Sophia (RevRec Lead): Short version: book deferred revenue in USD at invoice date. Recognize revenue later using that historical USD basis. FX on cash when collected -> FX gain/loss in the period cash hits. We'll add this to the close playbook.

Arjun (Accounting): Example journals:
```
# Invoice posted (2025-03-28)
DR Accounts Receivable 1,200,000 JPY → 8,831 USD
CR Deferred Revenue              8,831 USD

# Cash collected (2025-04-02)
DR Cash                           8,650 USD
DR FX Loss                         181 USD
CR Accounts Receivable             8,831 USD

# When revenue is recognized later (e.g., 2025-04-15):
DR Deferred Revenue               8,831 USD
CR Revenue                        8,831 USD
```

Marta (Finance): Thanks — two follow-ups: 1) So we'll book deferral at invoice USD and book any FX on collection in April (agreed). 2) CFO asked for APAC revenue by original currency — should we tag revenue schedules?

Liam (RevenueOps): Yes, add a dimension 'orig_currency' and 'region=APAC' on the rev schedules. I'll update the RevRec feed mapping; will ping when pushed.

billing-bot: Invoice 98765 applied to ACME-JP — 1,200,000 JPY ≈ 8,831 USD @0.007359 (invoice date). Cash received 2025-04-02 05:12 UTC: 1,200,000 JPY ≈ 8,650 USD @0.007208.

Sophia (RevRec Lead): I'll update month-end checklist: mark JPY invoices >50k as 'FX review' and attach the calc; add note to playbook: use invoice date spot to set deferral USD.

Marta (Finance): Great — I'll post the supporting calc and book the accrual reversal now. Ping if audit needs backup. :thumbsup:
